property_summary: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's stored feeRate after initialize must equal the _feeRate argument passed; the mutant that swaps assigning feeRate and changeFee can cause feeRate to be stored incorrectly for some inputs and thus violate this property.

After initialize(...) returns successfully, the stored feeRate equals the _feeRate parameter passed; the mutant that swaps assigning feeRate and changeFee can cause feeRate to be stored incorrectly for certain fuzzed inputs (due to overlapping storage/packing interactions), so the property will fail on the mutant for some inputs.

For any inputs to initialize, after a successful call the contract's public feeRate must equal the _feeRate argument; swapping the order of assigning feeRate and changeFee in the mutant can corrupt the stored feeRate for some packed-storage inputs, so the mutant will violate this rule for some fuzzed inputs.

For all inputs, after initialize(...) returns successfully the public feeRate must equal the _feeRate argument passed; the mutant that swaps the order of assigning feeRate and changeFee can corrupt feeRate due to storage packing for some fuzzed (_feeRate, _changeFee) pairs and thus violate this rule.
